$Comment:
The fourth find tier, for the worker who already holds the Sawmiller's Hatchet, alone in its own file for the same reason the chase in SawmillTrophy is: a Lootable folds by id and a later layer replaces a whole FILE, so any roll another mod is expected to re-tune must not sit beside rolls it would then inherit. This one is a prime candidate - it is the trophy's own payoff, and a progression mod layering its own reward onto the trophy will want to reshape it. The Sawmill's three tables split exactly along that line: SawmillFinds is the loyalty ladder anyone can reach, SawmillTrophy is the chase, and this is what the chase pays out.

Conditions demand ALL THREE tool axes at the Sawmiller's Hatchet's own values - quality 5 (Legendary), item level 50, and Woods gather power 0.55 through the Param-less tool_power form, which reads the station's own gather type. No forgeable vanilla tool reaches them (Mithril, the best, tops out at quality 4 and power 0.5), so only the trophy or a better modded tool unlocks this tier. Each of the three sits exactly one notch above the chase's own gate in SawmillTrophy, which is what makes the pair read as a ladder rather than two unrelated gates.

No cycle gate: the trophy already proved the loyalty its chase demanded, so this tier pays from the first cycle of a session. The same 15 percent per-cycle cadence as the loyalty ladder, into RPG_Station_Sawmill_T4 - the one find table in this jar with no empty entry, so a win here always pays.

Every number here is initial balance and retunes freely without any engine change.
